mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS attemptId, a.task_id AS taskId, t.name AS examName, p.name AS paperName, CASE WHEN a.status='SUBMITTED' AND t.show_result_immediately=1 THEN a.score END AS score, a.total_score AS totalScore, p.pass_score AS passScore, CASE WHEN a.status='SUBMITTED' AND t.show_result_immediately=1 THEN a.passed END AS passed, a.status AS status, a.attempt_no AS attemptNo, a.started_at AS startedAt, a.submitted_at AS submittedAt, CASE WHEN a.started_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, a.started_at, COALESCE(a.submitted_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))) END AS durationSeconds, ap.candidate_name AS candidateName, ap.phone AS phone FROM assessment_attempt a JOIN assessment_participant ap ON ap.id = a.participant_id JOIN assessment_task t ON t.id = a.task_id JOIN test_paper p ON p.id = t.paper_id WHERE (ap.user_id = #{userId} OR (ap.user_id IS NULL AND ap.phone = #{phone})) AND a.status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'PENDING_REVIEW', 'IN_PROGRESS') ORDER BY COALESCE(a.submitted_at, a.started_at) DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT aa.attempt_id AS attemptId, aa.question_id AS questionId, a.task_id AS taskId, t.name AS examName, COALESCE(qb.name, '') AS bankName, COALESCE(aq.snapshot_type,qi.question_type) AS questionType, COALESCE(aq.snapshot_stem,qi.stem) AS stem, COALESCE(aq.snapshot_answer,qi.answer_text) AS correctAnswer, qi.analysis AS analysis, aa.answer_text AS userAnswer, aa.answered_at AS answeredAt FROM assessment_answer aa JOIN assessment_attempt a ON a.id = aa.attempt_id JOIN assessment_participant ap ON ap.id = a.participant_id JOIN assessment_task t ON t.id = a.task_id JOIN question_item qi ON qi.id = aa.question_id LEFT JOIN assessment_attempt_question aq ON aq.question_id=aa.question_id AND aq.attempt_id=a.id LEFT JOIN question_bank qb ON qb.id = qi.bank_id WHERE t.show_result_immediately=1 AND COALESCE(aa.is_correct, 0) = 0 AND a.status = 'SUBMITTED' AND a.id = ( SELECT MAX(a2.id) FROM assessment_attempt a2 JOIN assessment_participant ap2 ON ap2.id = a2.participant_id WHERE a2.task_id = a.task_id AND a2.status IN ('SUBMITTED','PENDING_REVIEW') AND (ap2.user_id = #{latestUserId} OR (ap2.user_id IS NULL AND ap2.phone = #{latestPhone})) ) AND (ap.user_id = #{userId} OR (ap.user_id IS NULL AND ap.phone = #{phone})) ORDER BY aa.answered_at DESC, aa.id DESC
SELECT option_key AS `key`, option_text AS text FROM question_option WHERE question_id = #{questionId} ORDER BY sort_no, id
SELECT phone FROM app_user WHERE id = #{userId}
